e2_run2.label: analog_sd sets the simulation; the rest is reported, not deciding

design.construction: s28's E2 structure (review.s28_twin_pair_quantisation.e2s_chains, e2s_windows, e2s_stats, make_cell, analog_noise, recording_floor), at each segment's analog SD

decisions.rule: J_max_TA(s, f) = front_end_jmax over the five levels (the largest pass with no fail at or below it; unresolved does not block; None if none passes); J_max_TA(f) = combine_segments over A and B (None if either is None, else the minimum). Noise and swept CW decide; the chirp is reported. No tau cap (stationary AGC; run 2's tau side check gave none).

H_B.statement: mode B's excess / the true front end's <= 0.92: the yardstick reads low at weak jamming

reported_only.label: reported, not deciding
items: per cell: mode B's pair (ratio_B, ratio_B_se, b_over_truth, b_over_truth_se, var_dphi_B, cov2_B, excess_B, var_ratio_B, cancel_B, slope_B) and the variance and cancellation fields of the truth pair
the chirp: its cells (role) and J_max_TA(chirp) (decisions.families.chirp)
e2_run2: everything but analog_sd (n0_per_hz, the pre-registered J_max, the tau side check and tau cap)
segments.*.floor beyond n0_per_hz and analog_sd (which set the levels and mode B's reconstruction)

addendum: no real front-end filter beyond the flat +-10 MHz band
noted_by_the_implementer: segments A and B differ only in the analog SD (and so in N0 and every level's power): the white noise, the ghost, the jammer waveforms and the dither are the same draws (s28's seeds), so the two segments are not independent replications
N0 is the synthetic recording's (estimate_n0 on a flat band), not run 2's measured N0 (reported beside it); every level is set against its own N0
